lead: Use on any coding task to build at the simplest rung that holds, reuse before building, cut over-engineering and track debt, and to restructure a repo that has already accreted: a sprawling tree, god-files, shallow coupled modules.

ladder.cue: any coding task: the simplest rung that holds

reuse.cue: before building: what this repo and others already have

review.cue: hunt over-engineering in the diff, cut behind a check

debt.cue: inventory the debt: markers, and whether each still holds

capture.cue: wrapping up: what another project could use

restructure.cue: the whole sweep: organize, split god-files, deepen

organize.cue: the file tree alone: a bloated root, AGENTS.md hubs

deepen.cue: the seams alone: shallow modules, leaky interfaces
